# Submit an expense claim in the browser for the receipt open in Mousepad.
# Values from the request itself (not on screen): set them per task.
CLAIMANT = "Lin Okafor"
CONTRACTOR_COMPANY = "Brightwave Ltd"   # set to None for an employee
import re, time
from pathlib import Path

W = "Chromium"

# --- read the receipt file named in the Mousepad title
mp = [w for w in windows() if w["title"].endswith(" - Mousepad")][0]["title"]
path = Path(mp[: -len(" - Mousepad")].lstrip("*"))
txt = path.read_text()

def grab(pat):
    m = re.search(pat, txt, re.I | re.M)
    assert m, pat
    return m.group(1).strip()

def num(s):
    return float(s.replace(" ", "").replace(",", "."))

d, mo, y = re.search(r"Date:\s*(\d{1,2})[./-](\d{1,2})[./-](\d{4})", txt).groups()
d, mo = d.zfill(2), mo.zfill(2)
frm = grab(r"^From:\s*(.+)$")
to = grab(r"^To:\s*(.+)$")
km = num(grab(r"Distance:\s*([\d.,]+)"))
cur, total = re.search(r"Total\s+([A-Z]{3})\s*([\d .,]+\d)", txt).groups()
total = num(total)
vat = num(re.search(r"VAT[^:\n]*:\s*[A-Z]{3}\s*([\d .,]+\d)", txt).group(1))
paid_line = grab(r"^Paid:\s*(.+)$")
card = "card" in paid_line.lower() and ("corporate" in paid_line.lower() or "company" in paid_line.lower())
last4 = re.search(r"(\d{4})\s*$", paid_line).group(1) if card else None
low = (txt + path.name).lower()
mode = "Taxi" if "taxi" in low else "Train" if "train" in low or "rail" in low else "Flight"

# --- helpers
def fields(role):
    return [e for e in find(role=role, window=W) if "Address" not in e["name"]]

def pick(cb, label):
    act(cb, "focus", None); time.sleep(0.2); type_text(label); time.sleep(0.4)

def fmt(x):
    return ("%.2f" % x) if x != int(x) or True else str(x)

# --- top part of the form
act(fields("entry")[0], "set_text", CLAIMANT)
press("a contractor" if CONTRACTOR_COMPANY else "an employee", role="radio button", window=W)
time.sleep(0.5)
if CONTRACTOR_COMPANY:
    act(fields("entry")[1], "set_text", CONTRACTOR_COMPANY)
pick(fields("combo box")[0], "Travel")            # category -> reveals Travel fieldset
pick(fields("combo box")[1], mode)                # mode
en = fields("entry")
base = 2 if CONTRACTOR_COMPANY else 1
act(en[base], "set_text", frm)
act(en[base + 1], "set_text", to)
sp = [e for e in fields("spin button") if not e["name"]]   # km, amount, vat
act(sp[0], "set_text", str(int(km)) if km == int(km) else str(km))
act(sp[1], "set_text", "%.2f" % total)
act(sp[2], "set_text", "%.2f" % vat)
act(one("Day", role="spin button", window=W), "focus", None); time.sleep(0.2)
type_text(d + mo + y); time.sleep(0.3)
pick(fields("combo box")[2], cur)                 # currency

# --- lower part is only exposed once scrolled into view
click(640, 400); scroll(10); time.sleep(0.6)
pick(fields("combo box")[-1], "Corporate" if card else "My own")
time.sleep(0.4)
if card:
    act(fields("entry")[-1], "set_text", last4)
act(one("I confirm", role="check box", window=W), "check", None)
time.sleep(0.3)

# --- verify before submitting
vals = {e["name"]: e.get("value") for e in find(role="spin button", window=W) if e["name"]}
assert int(vals["Day"]) == int(d) and int(vals["Month"]) == int(mo) and int(vals["Year"]) == int(y), vals
texts = [e.get("text") for e in fields("entry")]
assert frm in texts and to in texts, texts
if card:
    assert last4 in texts, texts

press("Submit claim", role="button", window=W)
time.sleep(1)
titles = [w["title"] for w in windows()]
print(titles)
assert any(t.startswith("Task - complete") for t in titles), titles

import re, time

# 1. Read the ticket: config path, target port and log level
paras = " ".join((n.get("name") or "") + " " + (n.get("text") or "") for n in find())
path = None
for n in find(element=".ini"):
    if n["name"].strip().startswith("/") and n["name"].strip().endswith(".ini"):
        path = n["name"].strip(); break
if path is None:
    m = re.search(r"(/[^\s￼]+\.ini)", paras)
    path = m.group(1)
port = re.search(r"listen on port (\d+)", paras).group(1)
lvl_word = re.search(r"log only (\w+)", paras).group(1).lower()
level = {"warnings": "warning", "warning": "warning", "errors": "error", "error": "error",
         "info": "info", "debug": "debug", "criticals": "critical", "critical": "critical"}.get(lvl_word, lvl_word.rstrip("s"))
print("path", path, "port", port, "level", level)

# 2. Edit only the [server] section
orig = open(path).read()
def section_values(text):
    d, sec = {}, None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"\s*\[(.+?)\]", line)
        if m: sec = m.group(1).strip(); continue
        m = re.match(r"\s*([^#;=\s]+)\s*=\s*(.*)$", line)
        if m and sec: d[(sec, m.group(1))] = m.group(2).strip()
    return d
before = section_values(orig)
out, sec = [], None
for line in orig.splitlines(keepends=True):
    m = re.match(r"\s*\[(.+?)\]", line)
    if m:
        sec = m.group(1).strip()
    elif sec == "server":
        nl = "\n" if line.endswith("\n") else ""
        if re.match(r"\s*port\s*=", line):
            line = re.sub(r"^(\s*port\s*=\s*).*$", r"\g<1>" + port, line.rstrip("\n")) + nl
        elif re.match(r"\s*log_level\s*=", line):
            line = re.sub(r"^(\s*log_level\s*=\s*).*$", r"\g<1>" + level, line.rstrip("\n")) + nl
    out.append(line)
open(path, "w").write("".join(out))

# 3. Comment and resolve
entry = [n for n in find(role="entry") if "Address" not in (n["name"] or "")][0]
act(entry, "set_text", f"Set [server] port to {port} and log_level to {level} in {path.split('/')[-1]}; other sections unchanged.")
btns = [n for n in find(element="Resolve") if n["role"] in ("push button", "button")]
if btns:
    act(btns[0], "press")
else:
    cands = [n for n in find(element="Resolve") if n.get("actions")]
    act(cands[-1], "press" if "press" in cands[-1]["actions"] else cands[-1]["actions"][0])
wait(timeout=10, element="Resolved")

# 4. Checks
after = section_values(open(path).read())
assert after[("server", "port")] == port
assert after[("server", "log_level")] == level
for k, v in before.items():
    if k not in (("server", "port"), ("server", "log_level")):
        assert after.get(k) == v, k
assert find(element="Resolved")
print("ok")

# Mark all products of a defunct supplier as Discontinued with stock 0 in the
# paginated browser inventory table; leave every other row unchanged.
import time, re

SUPPLIER = "Norvik"            # exact supplier name (not prefixes like "Norvika")
STATUS = "Discontinued"

def norm(s): return " ".join((s or "").split()).casefold()

def dismiss_popups():
    for name in ("Stay signed in",):
        for n in find(element=name, role="button"):
            act(n, "press"); time.sleep(0.4)

def page_label():
    scroll(40); time.sleep(0.4)
    for n in find(text="Page "):
        m = re.search(r"Page (\d+) of (\d+)", n.get("text") or n.get("name") or "")
        if m: return int(m[1]), int(m[2])
    return 1, 1

def page_rows():
    dismiss_popups()
    seen = {}
    scroll(-60); time.sleep(0.6)
    stale = 0
    for _ in range(60):
        before = len(seen)
        for r in rows():
            if len(r) >= 5 and r[0] != "SKU" and r[0].strip():
                seen[r[0]] = [c.strip() for c in r[:5]]
        stale = stale + 1 if len(seen) == before else 0
        if stale >= 3: break
        scroll(3); time.sleep(0.3)
    return seen

def is_target(r): return norm(r[2]) == norm(SUPPLIER)
def is_done(r): return r[3] == "0" and r[4] == STATUS

def edit(sku):
    dismiss_popups()
    press(element="Edit", role="button", within=sku); time.sleep(0.6)
    act(one(role="spin button"), "set_text", "0")
    act(one(role="combo box"), "open"); time.sleep(0.5)
    items = find(role="menu item")
    names = [n["name"] for n in items]
    cur = next((i for i, n in enumerate(items) if "selected" in n["states"]), 0)
    tgt = names.index(STATUS)
    for _ in range(abs(tgt - cur)): key("Down" if tgt > cur else "Up")
    key("Return"); time.sleep(0.4)
    press(element="Save", role="button", exact=True); time.sleep(0.6)

def goto_first_page():
    for _ in range(50):
        p, _t = page_label()
        if p <= 1: return
        dismiss_popups()
        press(element="Previous", role="button", exact=True); time.sleep(0.7)

dismiss_popups()
goto_first_page()
before, after, edited = {}, {}, []
while True:
    p, total = page_label()
    rows_now = page_rows()
    before.update(rows_now)
    for sku, r in rows_now.items():
        if is_target(r) and not is_done(r):
            edit(sku); edited.append(sku)
    after.update(page_rows())
    p, total = page_label()
    if p >= total: break
    dismiss_popups()
    press(element="Next", role="button", exact=True); time.sleep(0.7)

# Second full pass to verify the final state from scratch.
goto_first_page()
final = {}
while True:
    final.update(page_rows())
    p, total = page_label()
    if p >= total: break
    dismiss_popups()
    press(element="Next", role="button", exact=True); time.sleep(0.7)

print("edited:", edited)
assert final, "no rows read"
assert set(final) == set(before), f"row set changed: {set(final) ^ set(before)}"
targets = [s for s, r in final.items() if is_target(r)]
assert targets, f"no {SUPPLIER} products found"
for sku, r in final.items():
    if is_target(r):
        assert is_done(r), f"{sku} not updated: {r}"
    else:
        assert r == before[sku], f"{sku} changed: {before[sku]} -> {r}"
print("OK", len(targets), "products marked", STATUS)
